sanskrit: * * * * ścalaulyaṃ ca ṣaḍbhiryogo vinaśyatijanasaṃgaparityāgāt ṣaḍbhiryogaḥ prasidhyatiaṃgīkṛtānyāsanāni kathyaṃte kāni cinmayātat kuryādāsanasthairyamārogyaṃ cāṃgalāghavaṃṛjukāyaḥ samāsīta svastikaṃ tat pracakṣyatedakṣiṇe tu tathā savyaṃ gomukhaṃ gomukhaṃ yathāitarasmistathā coruṃ vīrāsanamitīritaṃkūrmāsanaṃ bhavedetaditi yogavido viduḥvinyasya bhūmau saṃsthāpya vyomasthaḥ kukkuṭāsanaṃśeve kūrmavaduttānametaduttānakūrmakaṃdhanurākarṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā dhanurāsanamīritaṃpragṛhya tiṣṭhan parivartitāṃgaḥ śrīmatsyanāthoditamāsanaṃ syātjānū parinyastalalāṭa deśoviśedidaṃ paścimatā na vāhuḥudaraṃ jaṭharānalasya kuryādudare kārśpamarogatāṃ ca puṃsāṃuccāsanodaṃḍa vadutthitaḥ khemāyūra metatpravadaṃti pīṭhaṃkālakūṭaṃsarvāsana bhrāṃti haraṃ citta vibhrāṃti sādhanaṃtebhyaścatuṣkamādāya sārabhūtaṃ vravīmyahaṃśreṣṭhaṃ tatrāpi ca sakhe tiṣṭha siddhāsane sadābhedajanakaṃ siddhāsanaṃ procyategulphāṃtaraṃ ca nikṣipya siddhāsanamidaṃ bhavetmuktāprāṇaṃ vadatyanye prāhurguptāsanaṃ paremukhyaṃ sarvāsaneṣvekaṃ siddhāḥ siddhāsanaṃ viduḥdvāsaptati sahasreṣu suṣumṇāmiva nāḍiṣusadā siddhāsanābhyāsādyoginīpyaṃti māpnuyāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00501 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāṇānile sāvadhānaṃ vaddhe kevala kuṃbhataḥathekasminneva dṛḍhaṃ vaddhe siddhāsane sadāna khecarī samā mudrā na nāda sadṛśolayaḥvināśakāriyamināṃ padmāsanaṃ procyateūru madhye tayottānau pāṇī kṛtvā tato dṛḍhauuttabhya civukaṃ vakṣasphacchāpya pavanaṃ śanaiḥdurlabhaṃ yena kenāpi dhīmatā labhyate bhuviprāṇāmupaiti vodhamatulaṃ śaktipramāvādataḥmārutaṃ dhārayedyastu samukto nātra saṃśayaḥdakṣiṇe savyagulpha ca dakṣagulphaṃ ca savyakevyātta vaktro nirīkṣena nāsāgaṃ susamāhitaḥvaṃdhasya saṃdhānaṃ kurute cāsanottamaṃpārśvapādau ca pāṇibhyāṃ dṛḍhaṃ vadhvā suniścalaṃgorakṣāsanamidaṃ vai prāhuste siddhayoginaḥathābhyasennāḍi śuddhaṃ mudrādi pavana kriyāṃatha nādānusaṃdhānamabhyāsānukramo haṭheavdādūrdhvaṃ bhavet siddho nātrakāryāvicāraṇābhujyate śivasaṃprītyai mitāhāraḥ sa ucyateatilavaṇāsavapalalaṃkadaśanaśākotkaṭapiṣṭaṃprātaḥ snānopavāsādi kāyaṃ kleśa vidhiṃ tathāpathyaṃmanobhilaṣitaṃ yogyaṃ yogī bhojanamācaretabhyāsāt siddhimāpnoti sarvayogeṣvataṃdritaḥsarvopyayaṃ haṭhābhyāso rājayoga phalāvadhiḥgurūpadiṣṭamārgeṇa prāṇāyāmān samabhyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00501 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yogī sthāṇutvamāpnoti tato vāyuṃ nirodhayetcidanyaḥmaraṇaṃ tasya niḥkrāṃtistanovāyuṃ nirodhayetkathaṃ syādunmanī bhāvaḥ kāyasiddhiḥ kathaṃ bhavettadaiva jāyate yogī prāṇasaṃgrahaṇe kṣamaḥyathā suṣumṇā nāḍīsthā malāśeṣaṃ prayāṃti cadhārayitvā yathāśaktirbhūyaḥ sūryeṇa recayetvidhivat kuṃbhakaṃ kṛtvā punaścaṃdreṇa recayetrecayecca tatonyevaśanaireva na vegataḥpītvā piṃgalayā samīraṇamatho vaddhvā tyajedvāmayāśuddhānāḍī gaṇā bhavati yamināṃ māsatrayādūrdhvataḥuttiṣṭhatyuttame prāṇarodhe padmāsanaṃ mahuḥdṛḍhatā laghunā vāpi tena gātrasya jāyatetatobhyāsedṛḍhībhūtena tathā niyamagrahaḥtathaiva sādhito vāyuranyathā haṃti sādhakaṃayuktābhyāsa yogeṇa sarvarogasamudbhavaḥbhavaṃti vividhā doṣāḥ pavanasya vyatikramātyuktaṃ yuktaṃ ca vadhnīyādevaṃ śuddhimavāpnuyātkāyasya kṛśatākāṃtistadājāyata niścitaṃnādābhivyaktirārogyaṃ jāyate nāḍi śodhanātanyastu nācaret tāni doṣāṇāṃ samabhāgikaḥkapāli bhāti caitāni ṣaṭkarmāṇi pracakṣatevicitraguṇasaṃdhāyi pūjaye stuti puṃgavaiḥtataḥ pratyāhareccaitaduditaṃ dhauti karma tatdhauti karma prabhāvena gacchaṃtyeva na saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00501 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ādhārākuṃcana kuryā kṣālanaṃvasti karmakṛtvastikarmaprabhāveṇa vāryaṃte sa kalāmayāḥaśeṣa doṣopacayaṃmihanyādabhyasya mānaṃ jalavasti karmakramaparicaya vaśya vāyumārgā gajakaraṇīti gadyate haṭhajñaiḥnaśāmukhānnirgamayeccaiṣānīti siddhairnigadyatejānūrdhvajātarogaughaṃ jagatyāśu satīnatiaśru saṃpātaparyaṃtamācāryaistrāṭakaṃ smṛtaṃyatnataḥ trāṭakaṃ gopyaṃ yathā hāṭakapeṭakaṃnatāṃso bhramayed deṣānauligauḍaiḥ prakāśyateaśeṣadoṣāmaya śoṣaṇī ca haṭhakriyā mauliriyaṃ ca naulīkapālabhātī vikhyātā kaphadoṣo viśoṣiṇīprāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kuryādanāyāsena sidhyatiācāryāṇāṃ tu keṣāṃ cidanyat karma na saṃmataṃabhūvannaṃtakabhayāstasmāt pavanamabhyasetsamanaskoṃtakabhayaṃ tasmāt pavanamabhyasetyāvat paścodbhruvormadhyaṃ tāvat kālabhayaṃ kutaḥsuṣumṇā vadanaṃ bhitvā mukhādviśati mārutaḥyo manaḥ susthirī bhāvaḥ saiṣāvasthā manonmanīvicitra kuṃbhakābhyāsādvicitrāṃ siddhimāpnuyātbhastrikā bhramarī mūrchā kevalaścāṣṭakuṃbhakāḥkuṃbhakāṃte recakādau kartavyaḥ sūḍiyāṇakaḥmadhye paścimatānena syāt prāpyo brahmanāḍigaḥyogījarā vinirmuktaḥ ṣoḍaśīvayasā bhavetdakṣanāḍyā samākṛṣya bahisthaṃ pavanaṃ śanaiḥtataḥ śanairvāmanāḍyā recayet pavanaṃ śanaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00501 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: punaḥ punaridaṃ kāryaṃ sūryabhedenamuttamaṃyathālagati kaṃṭhāttu hṛdayāvadhi sasvanaṃśleṣadoṣaharaṃ caivaṃ dehānalavivardhanaṃgacchatāṃ gacchatāṃ kāryamujjāpyākhyaṃ tu kuṃbhakaṃevamabhyāsa yogena kāmadevo dvitīyakaḥna kṣudhā na tṛṣā nidrā naivālasya prajāyateanena vidhinā nityaṃ yogīṃdro bhuvimaṇḍaleaṣṭhāddūrdhva bhavet tasya sarvaroga parikṣayaḥśanaistu ghrāṇaraṃdhrābhyāṃ recayedanilaṃdhiyāviṣāṇī śītalīnāma kuṃbhakāyaṃ nihaṃti capadmāsanaṃ bhavet samyak sarvapāpa pranāśanaṃmukha niyamya yatnena prāṇaṃ ghrāṇena recayetvegena pūrayet kiṃciddhṛdayāvadhi mārutaṃyathaivalohakārāṇāṃ bhastrāvegeṇa cālpatedhārayennāsikāṃ madhya tarjanībhyāṃ vinā dṛḍhaiḥvātapittaśleṣmaharaṃ dehānalavivardhanaṃbrahmanāḍī mukhāṃtastha kaphādyārgalanāśanaṃviśeṣeṇa tu kartavyaṃ bhastrākhyaṃ kuṃbhakaṃ tvidaṃyogīṃdrāṇāmevamabhyāsa yogāccittejātākā cidānaṃdamūrchārecayen mūrchanākhyeyaṃ manomūrchā sukhapradāpayasyagādhepi sukhāt plavate padmapatravatsahitaḥ kevalaśceti kuṃbhako vividho mataḥyāvat kevalasiddhiḥ syāt tāvadevaṃ samabhyasetprāṇāyāmo yamityuyuktaḥ savai kevalakuṃbhakaḥna kiṃtu durlabhaṃ tasyā triṣu lokeṣu vidyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00501 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rājayogapadaṃ samyak labhate nātra saṃśayaḥna sidhyaṃti tato yugmamāniḥṣyanteḥ samabhyasetevamabhyāsa yogena rājayogapadaṃ vrajetanargalā suṣumnā ca haṭhasiddhiśca jāyatearogatā viṃdujayogni dīrghatā bhaveyuretāni kṛtetra kuṃbhakesarveṣāṃ yogataṃtrāṇāṃ tathāraudho hi kuṃḍalītadā sarvāṇi padmāṇi bhidyate graṃthayopi cayata cittaṃ nirālambaṃ tathā kālasya vaṃcanaṃbrahmadvāramukhe suptāṃ mudrābhyāsaṃ samabhyasetūḍīyāṇo mūlavaṃdho vaṃdhojālaṃ dharābhidhaḥidaṃ hi mudrā daśakaṃ jarāmaraṇanāśakaṃvallabhaṃ sarvasiddhānāṃ durlabhaṃ marutānapikasyacinnaiva vaktavyaṃ kulastrī surataṃ yathāpādaṃ prasāritaṃ kṛtvā karābhyāṃ dhārayed dṛḍhaṃyathā daṃḍahataḥ sarpo daṃḍākāraḥ prajāyatetadāsau maraṇāvasthā jāyate dvipuṭāśritāiyaṃ khalu mahāmudrā mahāsiddhaiḥ praśasyatemahāmudrā ca te naiva vadaṃti vivudhottamāḥyāvatulyā bhavet saṃkhyā tato mudrāṃ visarjayetapi bhuktaṃ rasayoraṃ * pīyūṣamivajīryatetasya rogāḥ kṣayaṃ yāṃti mahāmudrāṃ ca yo bhyasetgopanīyā prayatnena na deyā yasya kasyacitvāmorūpari saṃsthāpya dakṣiṇaṃ caraṇaṃ tathāniḥpīḍyayonimākucyamanormadye niyojayetsavyāṃge ca samabhyasya gakṣāṃge punarabhyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00501 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rājadaṃtadvayaṃ tatra jihvayāttaṃ bhayeditikālapāśa mahāvaṃdho vimocana vicakṣaṇaḥtriveṇī saṃgamaṃ dhatte kedāraṃ prāpayenmanāḥmahāmudrā mahāvaṃdhau niḥphalau vidhivarjitauvāyūnāṃgati māvṛtya nibhaṃtaṃ kaṇṭhamudrayājaṃghā dvayaṃ samākṛṣya vāyuḥ sphurati satvaraṃmṛtāvasthā samutpannā tato vāyuṃ virecayetvalīpalita vedhaghnaḥ kathyate sādhakottamaiḥvahni vṛddhikaraṃ ciṃtadaṇimādiśunapradaṃpuṇyasaṃbhārasaṃbhāvi pāpaughabhiduraṃ tathāvahnistrīpatha sevānāṃmādau varjana mācarettāvadyāvat bhrūmadhyaṃ rasanāspṛśati khecarībhruvoraṃtargatā dṛṣṭirmudrā bhavati khecarīkṣaṇena mucyate vyādhi jarāmṛtyu bharādikaiḥna ca mūrchā bhavet tasya yo mudrāvetti khecarīvādhyatena sakālena yasya mudrāsti khecarītenaiṣā khecarī nāma mudrāsiddhairnamaskṛtāna tasya kṣarate viṃduḥ kāminyā śleṣitasya canayedūrdhvaṃ haṭhācchaktyā nivaddhe yoni mudrayāmāsārdheṇa na saṃdeho mṛtyuṃ jayati yogavittakṣakenāpi daṣṭasya viṣaṃ tasya na sarpatitathā somakalāpūrṇaṃ dehī dehaṃ na muṃcatikulīnaṃ tamahaṃmanye tvitare kulaghātakaḥgomāṃsa bhakṣaṇaṃ tattu mahāpātaka nāśanaṃcaṃdrādravati yaḥ sāraḥ sasyādamaravāruṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00501 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rasanāniyamya vivare śaktiṃ parāṃ ciṃtayannirdoṣaḥ samṛṇālakomalatanuryogī ciraṃ jīvatisyādamaratvamaṣṭaguṇitaṃ siddhāṃgaṇākarṣaṇaṃeko devo nirālaṃvo ekāvasthā manonmanītadvadhnīyāsukaraṇamathonānyathākāya siddhiḥapānamūrdhvamākṛṣya mūlavaṃdho nigadyateākuṃcanena taṃ prāhurmūlavaṃdhaṃ ca yoginaḥvāraṃvāraṃ yathā cordhvaṃ samoyāti samīraṇaḥgatvā yogasya saṃsiddhaṃ gacchato nātra saṃśayaḥyuvā bhavati vṛddhopi satataṃ mūlavandhanāttadānala sikhaṃ dīrghāvardhate vāyunāhatādaṃḍāhatā bhujagīvaniḥśvasya ṛtujā vrajettasmānnityaṃ mūlavaṃdhaḥ kartavyo yogibhiḥ sadātasmāduḍyāpākākhyoyaṃ yogibhiḥ samudāhṛtaḥuḍyāṇaṃ tu tadeva syāt tatra vaṃdhobhidhīyateuḍḍiyāṇo hyayaṃ vaṃdho mṛtyumātaṃga kesarīabhyasedaniśaṃ yogī vṛddhopi taruṇo bhavetṣaṇmāsābhyāsayogeṇa jarāmṛtyuṃ na saṃśayaḥgulphadeśa samīpe ca kaṃpaṃ tatra prapīḍyateśanaiḥ śanairyathā prāṇaḥ skaṃdhasaṃdhi na gacchatiuḍiyāṇe kṛte vaṃdhe muktiḥ svābhāvikīṃ bhavetvaṃdho jālāṃdharākhyoyaṃ mṛtyormṛtyuparo mataḥtato jālādhano vaṃdhaḥ kaṃṭha duḥkhaughanāśanaṃna pīyūṣaṃ pacatyagnau na ca vāyuḥ pradhāvatimadhya cakramidaṃ jñeyaṃ ṣoḍaśādhāravaṃdhanaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00501 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarveṣāṃ yogataṃtrāṇāṃ sādhanaṃ yogināṃ viduḥmadhye paścimatāne syāt prāṇaraṃdhre brahmaraṃdhragaḥiḍā ca piṃgalā vadhvā vāhayet paścimaṃ payaṃtato na jāyate mṛtyurjarārogādikaṃ tathākaraṇaṃ viparītākhyaṃ guruvākyena labhyateāhāro vahulastasya saṃpādyaḥ sādhakasya tuadhaḥ śiraścorddhapādaḥ kṣaṇaṃ syāt prathame dinebalitaṃ palitaṃ caiva ṣaṇmāsārdhena duṣyatesvecchayā vartamānopi yogoktairniyamairvinātatra vastu dvayaṃ manye durlabhaṃ yasya kasyacitmohanairna śanaiḥ samyagūrdhvā kuṃcanamabhyasetyatnataḥ śarajālena phūtkāraṃ kajjakaṃdharaṃcakritanijaviṃduṃ ca ūrdhvamākṛṣya rakṣayetmaraṇaṃ viṃdupātena jīvitaṃ viṃdudhāraṇātsugaṃdhiryogino deho jāyate viṃdudhāraṇātcittāyattaṃ nṛṇāṃ śukraṃ śukrāyattaṃ ca jīvatiṛtumatyārajopyevaṃ nijaviṃduṃ ca rakṣayetayaṃ yogaḥ puṇyavatāṃ dhanyānāṃ tatvaśālināṃsahajoliśrāmarolirvajjālpā eva vodhataḥvajjolīmehanādūrdhvaṃ strīpuṃso svāṃga lepanaṃsahajauliriyaṃ proktā śraddhayā yogibhiḥ sadāpuṃso viṃdu samākuṃcya samyagabhyāsa pāṭavānyadi nārī rajo rakṣedvajjolyā sahayoginītasyāḥ śarīre nādastu viṃdunāmava gacchativajjolyābhyāsa yogena sarvasiddhiṃ prakurvate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00501 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dehasiddhiṃ ca labhate vajjolyābhyāsayogataḥtasmāt puṇya vatāmeva hyayaṃ yogaḥ prasidhyatikuṃḍalyaruṃdhatī hyeva śabdāparyāya vācakāḥkuṃḍalinyā tathā yogī mokṣadvāraṃ vibhedayemukhenācchādyate dvāraṃ prasuptā parameśvarīvaṃdhanā yaṃtramūḍhānāṃ yogināṃ mokṣadāyikāsā śaktiścālitā yena samukto nātra saṃśayaḥvalātkāreṇa gṛhṇīyāt tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padāṃnidrāṃ vihāya sā ṛjvī urdhvamuttiṣṭhate haṭhātprasūrya sūryāt paridhāna yuktā pragṛhya nityaṃ paricālanīyāmṛdulaṃ dhavalaṃ proktaṃ ceṣṭatāṃvara lakṣaṇaṃmṛtyucakra gatasyāpi tasya mṛtyubhayaṃ kutaḥvitaraṃ chinnadrumaskaṃdhavatevamabhyāsato nityaṃ yaminaḥ śaṃkate yamaḥevamabhyāsa yuktasya śaminoyamina kutaḥūrdhvamākṛṣyate kiṃcit suṣumnāgata kuṃḍalījahāti tasmāt prāṇoyaṃ suṣumnāṃ vrajati svataḥyasmāt saṃcālenāśu yogī rogairvimucyatekimatra vahunoktena kālaṃ jayati līlayāmaṃḍalāt dṛśyate siddhiḥ kuṃḍalyabhyāsayogataḥtadvāreduttamāge tu divyadṛṣṭipradāyakaṃkutaḥ prakṣālanopāyaḥ kuṃḍalyābhyāsanā dṛtekaraṇe sarvasiddhīnāmekaikāpi kṣamaiva sārājayogaṃ vinā mudrā vicitrāpi na rājateitasrana ca kartavyā manovṛttirmaṇīṣiṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00501 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āsanaṃ prāṇasaṃyāma mudrābhiḥ sakalā bhavetrudrāṇī vā parāmudrābhadrāṃ siddhiṃ prayacchatisa eva suguruḥ svāmī sākṣādīśvara eva saḥaṇimādi guṇaiḥ soyaṃ jāyate kālavaṃcakaḥniraṃjanaṃ padaṃ yāṃti nityaṃ yatra parāyaṇāḥmārutasya layo nāthastaṃ nātha mahamāśrayeniśceṣṭo nirvikāraśca layo jayati yogināṃsvāvargalabhyaye jñāpi jīvatyā caṃdratārakaṃvedaśāstrapurāṇāni sāmānya gaṇikā ivaaṃtarlakṣaṃ vahirdṛṣṭirnimeṣonmeṣavarjitāvivarjitaṃ sphurati yat tatvaṃ padaṃ śāṃbhavaṃbhinne ca sravate caṃdrādamṛtaṃ divyarūpiṇaḥtatrāsti karaṇaṃ divyaṃ sūryasya paripaṃthi caidaṃ sarvātmanā śiṣyai rūpāsīta tato guruṃnādānusaṃdhānakamekamevamanyāmahemukhyatamaṃ layānāṃśṛṇuyāṃ dakṣiṇe karṇe nādamaṃtasthamekadhīḥnāda prakartinaṃ cittaṃ nādena saha sāmyatiekībhūyādatha saha cidākāśena līyateunmanīkaraṇaṃ sadyonāda evāvadhāryatenādasyaivānu saṃvaṃdhā dvidhā cittaṃ pralīyateniṣpattiḥ sarvayogeṣu yogāvasthā bhavaṃtitāḥvicitra tatkṣaṇādehe sarvataḥ śrūyate dhvaniḥsaṃpūrṇe hṛdayaṃ śūnye tvāraṃbho yogino bhavetdṛḍhāsano bhavedyogī jñānādeva samestathāatiśūnye mardalasya bherīśabdastathā bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00501 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahāśūnyaṃ tadā yāti sarvasiddhi samāśrayaḥsukhaduḥkha jarāmṛtyu kṣudhānidrā vivarjitaḥekabhūtaṃ tadā cittaṃ rājayogābhidhānakaṃastu vāmastu vā śakti gātre vā khaṃḍitaṃ mahatsevakān karṣakān manye prayāse phalavarjitānunmanī kalpalatikā sadya eva bhaviṣyatiamaraścāpi cādvaitaṃ nirālaṃvaṃ niraṃjanaṃjīvanmuktiśca sahajaṃ turīyaṃ tveka vācakaṃtatvaṃ paraṃ tathā śakhyaṃ nādopāsanameva canāda eka susaṃdhyeyo yogasāmrājyamicchatātatra cittaṃ sthiraṃ kuryād yāvasthira padaṃ vrajettatrāsu prathamābhyāse nādo nānāvidho mahānyatra yatrāpi nāde calagati prathamaṃ manaḥmanonmatta gajendrasya viśramodyānacāraṇaḥśravaṇamukha nayananāsā nirodhane naiva kartavyaṃjñātvā suṣumnā saṃbhedaṃ kṛtvā vāyuṃ ca madhyagaṃtathā vasiṣṭavacanaṃcaṃdrastāmasa ityuktaḥ sūryo rājasa ucyaterājayoga samārūḍhaḥ puruṣaḥ kālapaṃcakaḥhaṃsāpi yogāmāhi kalavalamilaṃ hraṃ hūṃ svāhā || 17 || iti haṃsīvidhiḥ ||vicitre citracailāṃcala dehi vāsaḥ pūraya 2 pūṃ svāhāvicitrīttaṃ vicitra khela 2 ṇī prasanna śrīguru āṇasiddhāvī śrīṃ svāhāoṃ vidhātri nīrakṣīra vidhāyini viṭ svāhāhili vili ke ḍe ke ke ḍe bhīṃ vīṃ bhuṃ svāhā || 14 || iti vidhātrīvidhiḥ ||oṃ vainateyākṣi sarpa sevite nāgadevi sphīṃ svāhā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00501 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kuṭajākṣi kaṃvalaṃ dehi 2 bhīṃdhaṃ svāhāiralaṃgahū iti kāminī bhuvaṃ || 17 || iti kuṭajākṣī ||oṃ śubhaṃkari paradevate mameṣṭaṃ dehi 2 śuṃbhaṃ śrī svāhāoṃ śatanāde yoginiyogaṃ dehi 2 hrīṃ hrūṃ svāhāsvāhāoṃ paṃkajākṣi amṛtaphalaṃ dehi 2 svīṃ svāhānamaḥbhrūṃ varaṃ sphrīṃ svāhāpāṃḍavi iṃdu agamaṃḍalapaṃṭī kālukuṃṭimāḍḍadrī sphrīṃ svāhācitraṃ cakhusīmāradhana apārabhaurīṃ svāhā || 16 || iti citrākṣī ||citrakaṃṭhī citranādasvaraṃ dehi 2 bhīṃ rīṃ svāhāidānīṃ śrotumicchāmi samayācāramuttamaṃpuṇyaśca śrotumicchāmi ṣaḍāmnāyeṣu kīrtitaṃtasya saṃketa vijñānaṃ vāṃchitaṃ phalamaśnutepṛthak pṛthak kṛte nātha punarvrūhi maheśvarajapamālāsanānāṃ ca teṣāṃ vada dayānidhesamayācārasaṃketaṃ tatvaṃ paramadurlabhaṃsa kālaḥ samayo nāma ye jñātvā'mṛtamaśnutetaṃ nāma samayācāraṃ devānāmapi durlabhaṃsamayācārasaṃketaṃ nāmnā tatra prakīrtitaṃsamayā gopanīyānāṃ sadā gopyā prakīrtitāḥte narāstadgatā nityaṃ bhogaṃ kṛtvā sadā bhuviasyā vidhānakathanādidṛtaṃtraṃ prakīrtitaṃkathitaṃ vidhinā bhadre tat śṛṇuṣva varānaneyena śrutvā siddhi mūlībhakṣitā phaladā bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00501 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhairavānaṃda hetustu sa paṭhitvā sadā bhavabhavānīṃ bhavasaṃtāpapavirvāṇa sudhānidhimrājāprajāvaśakarī kālakaṃṭhī triśūlinīānaṃdādyāhutiḥ samyak jñānaṃ prayacchatiārādhayāmi vahuśatru parājayaṃti viśveśvarīṃ tribhuvane vijayeti devīmullāsa kadalīkaṃde svacchaṃde vodharūpiṇīapaharati durita nilayaṃ kiṃ kiṃ na karoti saṃvidullāsaḥbhakṣitābhavanāśāya nirgaṃdhā vodharūpiṇīvaiṣṇavī tulasī tuṃgā tejo vallīraseśvarīsamayā modinī caiva siddhamaulī mahauṣadhīyāni caitāni nāmāni sevayet siddhimūlikāmpāṃḍityaṃ sukavitvaṃ ca maṃtrasiddhiṃ sa viṃdativinā na samayā devi bhuktiṃ muktiṃ kathaṃ labhetsāmarthaṃ sahito devi kāryāṇi sādhayetbrāhme muhūrte cotthāya pakṣitā pāpanāśinītathā parāhne vidhivat sarvapāpavināśanivinā tu samayā devi japapūjādikaṃ caretapamṛtyuharānūnaṃ rogaśokavināśinīsiddhayo hyaṇimādyāśca tasya haste sadaiva hietat sarvaṃ kṣayaṃ yāṃti brahmahatyādi pātakaṃsamayāpāsitā yena rahitaḥ sarvakilviṣaiḥsa eva muktimārgasthaḥ samayā yena bhakṣitāsamaṃstatphalamāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ varānanealpāyuśca bhavet sadyo devatā kopayeddhruvampramādā lopayedyastu nārakī bhavatī dhruvaṃ

sanskrit: teṣāṃ madhyena taṃ dravye dve nahye tu kadācanaśarkarāśītalaṃ toya bhairamapyāranālakaṃdhattūraṃ ca viṣaṃ devi dravyaṃ prāṇaprahārakamānaṃda paramaṃ brahma parāśaktiḥ sadāśivaḥānande cāpamānepi bhakṣayen na kadācanabuddhināśo bhaved devi tato mātrāṃmitāṃ caretityevaṃ samayācāra kathitaśca varānaneguroḥ sakāśāt yaṃtramaṃtraṃ nityaṃ japati yo naraḥnyāsaṃ kṛtvā punarmaṃtrī dravyādīn maṃtrayed budhaḥguruṃ śivaṃ tathā devīṃ nivedyāṃ * ca bhakṣayetjīvaḥ śivaḥ śivo jīvaḥ sa jīvaḥ kevalaḥ śivaḥsadāśivamayo bhūtvā dravyādīnāṃ cared yadisadāśivamayo bhūtvā paṃcamudrādikaṃ caretmohād vā kāmalobhādvāyaḥ kaścidiha vartatesamayo nāma yaḥ kālo mayāyā pūrvasūcitaḥprātamadhyāhnayoḥ kāla pradoṣaśca tṛtīyakaḥpaṃcamaṃ tvardharātraṃ ca paṃcakālāḥ prakīrtitāḥdinasya madhye yaḥ kālo dvitīyaḥ parikīrtitaḥbrāhme muhūrtemavadhi ardharātrādanaṃtaraṃśāṃtiḥ karma tathā vaśyaṃ staṃbhanaṃ dveṣakaṃ tathāśāṃtyarthaṃ prathamaḥ kālo madhyanye dveṣaṇe tathāuccāṭane paṃcamaśca ṣaṣṭho māraṇa karmaṇistaṃbhane kukkuṭo vidyādvajrayedvasya karmaṇipṛthivī staṃbhane jñeyā ākāśe dveṣaṇaṃ tathāyasya bhūto deya devī tatamaṃḍalasaṃyutam

sanskrit: śītāṃśu vījaṃ prathamesalisya dvitīyakepaṃcamaṃ vāyuvījaṃ ca agnivījaṃ tu māraṇeathedānīṃ pravakṣyāmi āmnāya phalakaṃ tathāsadāśivohaṃ bhagavānācāraḥ parikīrtitaḥevaṃ paścima āmnāya paścimasyāṃ diśi sthitaḥmukhamūrdhvaṃ kṛtaṃ devīṃ yatproktaṃ tvayi sannidhauadhomukhaṃ kṛtaṃ devi yatprokto girije priyeṣaḍāmnāyaśca kathitaścautpatti kramanāmataḥte te devāḥ pravakṣyāmi sādhakānāṃ sukhāya cabhuvaneśvarī annapūrṇā pūrvāmnāye prakīrtitāḥyasmin devān pravakṣyāmi sādhakānāṃ sukhāya cabhuvaneśī annapūrṇā sarvāmnāye prakīrtitaḥpratyaṃgirā bhavānī ca paścimāmnāya devatāmāaṃgī bhairavīcchinnā tathā dhūmāvatī matāsamasta bheda sahitā devatāya prakīrtitāḥparā prāsāda maṃtraśca ūrdhvārdhāya prakīrtitaḥūrdhvāmnāyoścādhaśca kevalaṃ mokṣadorbhavetyathokta vidhināva bhakṣe kṛtvā phalamavāpnuyātkṛtvā yenāśu labhate phalarāśikayoḥ paraṃuttarāmnāya deveśi teṣāmāśu phalapradadevapūjārato nityaṃ tathā ca viparo divāvidhivat kriyate śaktyā saha sarvaphalaṃ bhavetjaptā yenāśu labhate phalairdevaiḥ sudurlabhamatha muktamayī vāpi mokṣa phalapradāyinipravālamālā vaśyārthe sarvakārya phalapradā

sanskrit: putrajīvakajāmālā lakṣmīrvidyā pradāyinīsuvarṇaraupyamayīmālā sphaṭikī sarvakāmadārudrākṣanirmitā mālā sarvakāmaphalapradāsamāśritya japed vidyāṃ yathokta phalamaśnuteuttarāmnāye yā mālā girije te vadāmyahammahāśaṃkhamayī cātha vāṃchitārtha phalapradāsvarṇādi ratnaparyaṃtaṃ racitaṃ phaladā matāuduṃvara phalasyaiva sūkṣmasya ca kṛtā ca yāathedānīṃ pravakṣyāmi yaṃtrasya vidhimuttamaṃrukme ca ṣaḍva ca * mahāśaṃkhe sahasrakamsahasā kārya sidhyarthaṃ sthāpayet sphaṭikoparivāṃchitaṃ labhate maṃtrī nānyathā labhate phalammeṣāsanaṃ tu vaśyārthe ākarṣe vyāghracarma cagocarma staṃbhane devi staṃbhane ca gavājinaṃmāraṇe mahiṣaṃ vidyāt kramoddiṣṭaṃ tu vā caretūrṇāsanaṃ kaṃbalādyaṃ sarvakarma supūjitaṃsvarṇādi raktajaṃ devi mahāsaubhāgyavardhanamyenāśu labhate puṇyaṃ phalaṃ caiva sudurlabhamsā darśāsanakaṃ cāpi maithunāsanakaṃ tathākṛta maithunakaṃ cāpi vāṃchitārtha phalapradaṃsiddhipīṭhaṃ siddhikṣetre girau devālaye tathānadyāditīre vā kuryādguhā parvatamastakeveśyāgṛhe śmaśāne vā gatvā maithuna samācaretathavā svagṛhe rātrau bhaktimānyaḥ samācaretathedānīṃ pravakṣyāmi bhagapūjāṃ samāsataḥ

sanskrit: tenaiva manunāmaṃtrī bhagapūjāṃ karoti caśivo bhūtvā smared dehe tvātmānaṃ ca vibhāvayetyathokta kurute devi prāpyate paramaṃ padamjñātavyā yadvidhā devi sarvataṃtreṣu niścitaṃurṇāmadevatā maṃtrā vidyā strīnāma tat smṛtāpumāṃso huṃ phaḍaṃtāsyuḥ vājāṃtāsyuḥ striyo matāḥgraṃthanaṃ ca vidarbhaśca saṃpuṭo rodhanaṃ tathānāmavarṇāśca vidhinā maṃtrāṇāṃtaritāstathāmaṃtrārṇa dvaya madhyasthe sādhyānāmākṣaraṃ likhetādāvaṃte ca maṃtrasyānnāmnosau saṃpuṭasmṛtaḥnāmna adyaṃta madhyeṣu maṃtrasthodrodanaṃ mataṃmaṃtrasyāṃte bhaven nāma yogaḥ proccāṭane mataḥāgataḥ śivavaktrācca gataśca girijāmukhepāṇikāni ca śāstrāṇi kathitānyāgamasya caācāraḥ kathito yastu tayā ca kṛtavānbhuvipaṃcamudrādi rahito dakṣiṇācārasaṃjñakaḥaparāṇi ca sarvāṇi maṃtrāṇāṃ hṛdayāṇi casamāsataḥ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi vadāmyahaṃamarāṇi ca trīṇi syuḥ kathayāmi śubhānaneyāmalānyatra vakṣyāmi amarāṇi tathā punaḥśaktergaṇapateścaiva kārtike yasya pṛthak pṛthakuḍḍīśaḍāmaraṃ nāma bhūtaḍāmarakaṃ tathākathaṃ cādya pravakṣyāmi taṃtrāṇi ca varānanetasmānnoktāni taṃtreṣu kulācāra guru śṛṇusuveṣadhāri dakṣaśca satyavaktā priyaṃvada

sanskrit: śiṣyastvayi guṇairyukto gurubhaktirataḥ sadāsatyamabdhirgurau maṃtre devapūjana tatparaḥevaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyukto śiṣyaścāpi parīkṣakaḥsamayācārasaṃpanno dhanāḍhyaśca triyāvaraḥjñātvā maṃtraṃ vinā samyak phalamāpnoti pūjanemakārāḥ paṃca śubhage sāṃga karmasu hetavetathānāma bhaved devi tīrthaṃ yadjñāna durlabhaṃdevimaṃtre ca vidhivat tasyoktā siddhiruttamāḥte rahasye mayā proktā mīnāḥ siddhipradāyakāḥmudrā tāṃ vidhi prāhuścaṇakādīṃśca bharjitāntasyānāma bhaved devi mudrāmukti pradāyinītasya nāma bhaved devi paṃcamaṃ parikīrtitammatsye hyapi tṛtīyaṃ syānāma mudrā caturthakaṃpaṃcānāṃ paṃcanāmānimakārāṇi varānanepaṃcamasya tathā devimakārāḥ paṃcadurlabhāḥpaṃcamena vinā devi caṃḍīmaṃtraṃ vṛthā japettasya siddhiḥ kathaṃ devi śaktimaṃtraṃ japet kathaṃpaṃcamena vinā devi kathaṃ ca phaladā bhavettannāma mokṣo viduṣāṃ anudhānāṃ ca pātakaṃtathā viśeṣato devi paṃcamaṃ parikīrtitaṃbhagasya pūjane puṇyaṃ bhagasya paṃcame tathāna tatsukhaṃ japairhomairnnadānaistapasā tathāna tatpuṇyasamaṃ devi koṭi tīrthādi darśanaṃkṛtapaṃcamabhaktasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīṃaprasūnā viśeṣeṇa paṃcamārhā bhavet priye

sanskrit: avaśyaṃ paṃcamaṃ kuryācchaktimātraṃ maheśvaritadakṣayaṃ labhet puṇyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇānānābharaṇavastrādyaistathā dravyeṇa suṃdaritasyāstotraṃ prakuryācca viśeṣeṇa śṛṇu priyesnānārthaṃ devatānāṃ ca rahasyaṃ paramaṃ śṛṇurātrau paṃcamakāreṣu kṛtvā paṃcamamuttamamtasyā kuṃḍodbhavaṃ toyaṃ vijñeyaṃ bhuktimuktidamtasmin kiṃcijjalaṃ kṣiptvā tāmrapātreṣu dhārayetstriyo rajaśca prathama yasminvayasi jāyatesvayaṃbhū kusumaṃ nāma devatānāṃ ca prītayetattasvadevatānāṃ ca prakuryāt snānamuttamaṃsvagururdattamaṃtreṇa ṣaḍaṃganyāsamācarettato japādikaṃ kuryāccākṣayaṃ labhate phalamṣaḍāmnāyeṣu taṃtreṣu rahasyamidamīritamjīvatī bhartarī nārīṇāṃ paṃcamaṃ kārayet priyemṛte bhartari nārīṇāṃ paṃcamaṃ kārayed yadikuṃḍagolodbhave dravyaṃ abhāve śṛṇu suṃdariyasya kasya taroḥ puṇyaṃ gṛhīcāśu prayatnataḥubhayoḥ paṃcamaṃ tatra kurvīta vidhivannaraḥtajjalena prakurvīta devatā snānamuttamaṃvallī puṣpāṇi sarvāṇi taroḥ puṣpāṇi yāni catāni sarvāṇi śubhage devatābhyo niyojayetaparājitāḥ puṣpaṃ ca dvayaṃ puṣpaṃ ca yadbhavetkamalasya ca yatpuṣpaṃ yatpuṣpaṃ paṃcakasya capatrāṇāṃ vilvapatrāṇi pūjārthe ca śu * nane

sanskrit: kṛte pūrṇagiriṃ yogyaṃ tretā upāna saṃjñakaṃcatuḥpīṭhāni śubhage śaktideheṣu yāni tatśaktiḥ sarvaśarīraṃ tu pīṭhaṃ pūrṇagiriṃ mataṃstanauṃ jālaṃdhare jñeyaṃ kāmapīṭhaṃ bhagasmṛtaṃyeṣu pīṭheṣu saṃsthitvāyaṃ yaṃ yaṃ maṃtraṃ japet priyesarvāṃtaphalamāpnoti devatā suprasīdatisarvāsāṃ validānaṃ ca devatānāṃ śṛṇu priyenityaṃ svabhojane kāle mūlamaṃtreṇa sādhakaḥtataścānaṃdate devi śucistadgatavān bhavetsthāpayitvā valiṃ tatra viharecca yathā sukhaṃtasyāṃ valiṃ bhojanāṃte vinaivācamane kṛtekiṃcijjapādikaṃ kṛtvā tata ācamanādikaṃyathokta vidhinā kuryād yathoktaṃ phalamaśnutesātviko valarākhyāto māṃsaraktādi varjitaḥsādhakāstrividhā proktā sātvikā rājasāmatātāmasāśca tathā devī teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇaṃsātvikaṃ validānādi nityaṃ kuryāt prayatnataḥrājasaṃbalidānādi suveṣai rājasairyutaḥna śraddhā balidāneṣu pūjanādiṣu suṃdariathedānīṃ pravakṣyāmi mama maṃtrāṇi suṃdariaghorākhya mahāmaṃtramāpaduddhāraṇaṃ tathācaṃḍovaraṃ ca subhage ardhanārī naṭeśvaraṃjñātavyāni sadā bhadre ṣaḍāmnāyeṣu tāni cadakṣiṇācāra yogena japtvā phalamavāpnuyātsarvāmnāyena vidhinā śīghrakāla phalapradaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00501 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yaṃ yaṃ maṃtraṃ jape devi vīrastadgatamānasaḥtava maṃtrāṇi deveśi mama maṃtrāṇi yāni cayathā svayaṃbhuvā devi vedāścatvāra kīrtitaḥpāraṃparyepi te jñeyā śrutāmnāyeṣu bhedataḥsa cāmnāya śruti jñeyaḥ śrutiśca vedato labhetathātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramaṃ śubhaṃatra kasya japaṃ kuryāt sajjanādibhireva cajāpādikaṃ tatasyaiva yasya saṃgate manaḥduṣṭācārāt pramādādvā ālasyādvāpi suṃdarihīnavīryamavāpnoti maṃtrādikaṃ varānaneprathamaṃ jananaṃ nāma jīvanaṃ tu dvitīyakaṃpaṃcamamabhiṣekaśca vimukhī karṇaṣaṣṭhakamnavamaṃ dīpanaṃ nāma gopanaṃ daśamaṃ smṛtaṃmaṃtravarṇān japennityaṃ praṇavāṃtaritān kramātmanuvarṇān samālipya tāḍayeccaṃdanāṃbhasāpratyekaṃ vāyunāmaṃtrī tāḍanaṃ nāma tat smṛtamaśvattha pallavairmaṃtramabhiṣiṃcedviśuddhayemaṃtre malatraye devi vimalī karaṇe tvidamkuśodakena japtena pratyaṇaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ manoḥnayunā vāriṇā maṃtra tarpaṇaṃ tarpaṇaṃ bhavetjapyamānasya gopanaṃ tvapanaṃtvaprakāśanametān kṛtā japen maṃtraṃ sa doṣarahitaḥ priyesākāraṃ yad bhaved devi vahudhā tarpaṇādiṣuekamevāparaṃbrahma jyotirūpamanakṣaramrūpadvayaṃ tathā bhūtvā dehināṃ dehamavyayaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00501 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kecit subhage jānaṃti liṃgākārasya rūpiṇaḥstrījāti rūpā sarvatra sarvadeheṣu yā matātāsāṃ bhagastrikoṇaṃ ca kuṇḍaṃ proktaṃ tu cottamaṃtatta teṣāṃ viśeṣāśca naradehe varānanebhagaḥ kuṃḍaṃ ca subhage śivo liṃgaṃ prakīrtitamājyarūpaṃ mataṃ śukraṃ manohotā prakīrtitaḥevaṃ vijñāyayo maṃtrī manorūpaṃ ca brahmavityaṃ yaṃ kāmādikaṃ devi manasā ciṃtyakārayetyathokta devatā cārādyathokta phalamaśnuteasmin stotre ca samayā yāmayā parikīrtitāḥimāṃ vidyāṃ ca taṃtresmin rahasyā ye prakīrtitāḥgoptavyāśca prayatnena kathanīyā na kasyacitgopyāgopya punargopyāgopyāgopyā punaḥ punaḥaṃtṛśaktāśca subhage vahiḥ śaivā ca vaiṣṇavāḥācāro mama deveśi tavācāropi ca priyenānāśakti sahālāpairye kurvaṃti ca sādhakāḥādra śuṣkavibhāgena dvidhācāraḥ punaḥ śṛṇumakaraiḥ paṃcarahitaḥ śuṣkācāraḥ prakīrtitaḥpūrvāmnāyeṣu kathitā nānā taṃtre ca devatāḥviśeṣāt phaladā devi sādhakānāṃ jitātmanāmsarvāmnāyāśca kathitāstava pārśve pṛthak pṛthakgopyādgopyataro guhyo guhyādguhyataro mahānyadivettvat samāloke nārī bhavati niścalābhrāṃti māyāti rahitastadā sādhayituṃ priyeāgamācārastu priye sarvadā gopanaḥ smṛtaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00501 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sādhakāstu kalau devi māyā nidrādi saṃyutaḥahaṃ vuddhiratā nityaṃ tasmādgopyādviśeṣataḥśraṣṭhebhaḥ sādhakebhyaśca na prakāśyaṃ kadācanasiddhihānistu labhate sadā tasya prakāśanātuttarāmnāye yā mālā kathitā bhuvidurlabhāatha varṇamayī mālā alābhe hastayarvajāsphāṭikyāśca abhāve tu rudrākṣa phalanirmitāāsanānyuttarāmnāye kathitāni śubhānaneyatra pūjā abhāve tu pratimāsu prapūjayettāmre vā lekhayitvā tu nityaṃ vā sarpajet priyesarvatra sarvapūjāṃsu mūle naiva prapūjayetsarvadravyādya bhāve tu ārdrakaṃ tu prakīrtitammakāra paṃcābhāve tu paṃcamaṃ kārayet priyeevaṃ śrutvā tato devi samayācāramuttamaṃśivopyaṃtaḥ prasannobhūt svayaṃ ca parameśvaraḥsarvāṇyāgama taṃtrāṇi yāni yānyapi suṃdaricaturyugeṣu vartaṃte pārapāyopadeśataḥkṛpayā tava deveśi kiṃcit kiṃ varṇitaṃ śubhaṃetatsarvaṃ tu niyataṃ sarvasvamida me priyeṣaḍāmnāyeṣu kathitaṃ taṃtraṃ paramadurlabhaṃyadi cedvai varārohe mayā tubhyaṃ prakāśitaṃatastu gopayennityaṃ yaditvaṃ mama vallabhāśrīprathamaṃkarāṃvujagataṃ pātraṃ viśuddhipradaṃdvitīyamadhunā naṃdaika saṃvardhanaṃpātramahaṃ tṛtīyamadhunā vijñānavodhakṣamaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00501 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paṃcamakāratatva sahitaṃ pātraṃ caturthaṃ namaḥsadoditakaraṃ pātraṃ bhaje paṃcamaṃtarpaṇādravarasaṃpātraṃ bhaje ṣaṣṭhamaṃpūraṇe natvarayānandādikaṃ pātumāncāṣṭamamaṣṭasiddhikaraṇaṃ prauḍhaṃ prasannaṃ sadāyannavanātha śaktijananaṃ prauḍhaḥ pratāpoditaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00501 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
